mechanism: Levothyroxine may impair cyanocobalamin absorption in the terminal ileum through alterations in gastric pH and intrinsic factor availability, while cyanocobalamin deficiency can worsen levothyroxine-induced neurological symptoms.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients on long-term levothyroxine therapy; consider B12 supplementation if deficiency develops, and space doses by 4+ hours if supplementation is added.
